name: 59457 · Lewistown, MT
findings: ZIP 59457 (Lewistown) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59457 (Lewistown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 59457 (Lewistown) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
